title: A single deletion-to-addition switch keeps every native state and target
statement: The later assembly classifies original augmented components by local lifted exploration, erases small original components, and at the first width400 seed switches permanently to deterministic two-neighbor rectangle growth, open-strip wrapping and cylinder thickening. It stops on each actual first-majority flip, keeps full thermal companions and uses at most2n actual flips. Winding is handled by local exploration, not an assumed global lift.
